connectAi.commentLabel: Let an AI assistant help you with your recipes

toasts.noAccount: You need to create an account first

intro.title: What is this?
intro.body: This connects an AI assistant to your recipes, so you can ask it to look up, add, or edit them for you. You'll need an AI app that supports "MCP" connections.
intro.tokenPurpose: The address and connection code below are what your AI app uses to sign in as you. The connection code works like a password: anyone who has it can read and edit your recipes, so only paste it into an AI app you trust, and never share it. If you ever think it's been exposed, disconnect below to cancel it, then generate a fresh one.

steps.title: How to use it
steps.one: Open your AI app's settings and look for a section about connecting tools or servers (sometimes called "MCP", "connectors", or "integrations").
steps.two: Paste the address below where it asks for a server address or URL.
steps.three: Paste the connection code below where it asks for a token, key, or password.
steps.four: Save, and start asking your assistant about your recipes!

meta.title: About
meta.description: A quick tour of what Sauté can do — recipe and DIY features you might not have noticed yet.

about.commentLabel: A quick tour of features that aren't always obvious just from looking around the app.

variations.title: Recipe Variations
variations.description: Cooked someone else's recipe your own way? Hit "Submit a variation" on that recipe's page, and it shows up alongside the original instead of as a brand-new post.

recipeRef.title: Recipe-Linked Ingredients
recipeRef.description: An ingredient that's really its own recipe — a sauce, a dough, a pickle — can link straight to that recipe: use "Add recipe as ingredient" while creating or editing a recipe.

photos.title: Community Photos
photos.description: Anyone can add a photo to any recipe, not just its author — look for "Add a photo" on the recipe's page to show how it turned out for you.

diy.title: DIY Projects
diy.description: Sauté isn't just food — browse handmade soap, home remedies, and household fixes under the DIY tab.

stepPhotos.title: Photos on Every Step
stepPhotos.description: Beyond the main recipe photos, each instruction step has its own "Photo" field when creating or editing a recipe, to show exactly what a tricky step should look like.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: Favoriting a recipe bookmarks it and bumps it to the top when you browse, so it doesn't get buried.

linkVariation.title: Link an Existing Recipe as a Variation
linkVariation.description: Posted a recipe separately and want it folded into a family later? Link it as a variation from Settings › My Recipes.

mcp.title: Connect an AI Assistant
mcp.description: Generate a personal access token from the Connect to AI page so an AI tool can read, search, and create recipes on your account for you.
